issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
covered_actors: Network information service providers subject to the Algorithm Recommendation, Deep Synthesis, and Generative AI Interim Measures that provide services to the domestic public
Network information content dissemination platform service providers
Users uploading AI-generated or synthetic content to dissemination platforms
Any organization or individual (with respect to prohibitions on tampering with or forging labels)
prohibited_practices: Maliciously deleting, tampering with, forging, or concealing required AI-generated or synthetic content labels
Providing tools or services to others to maliciously delete, tamper with, forge, or conceal required labels
Harming the legitimate rights and interests of others through improper labeling means

evidence.quote: 服务提供者提供生成合成内容下载、复制、导出等方式时，应当确保文件中含有满足要求的显式标识。
evidence.quote_en: When service providers offer methods such as downloading, copying, or exporting generated or synthesized content, they shall ensure that the files contain explicit labels meeting the requirements.

evidence.quote: （四）对于确为、可能和疑似生成合成内容的，应当在文件元数据中添加生成合成内容属性信息、传播平台名称或编码、内容编号等传播要素信息；
evidence.quote_en: (4) For content confirmed, likely, or suspected to be generated or synthesized, dissemination element information such as attribute information of the generated or synthesized content, the name or code of the dissemination platform, and the content identifier shall be added to the file metadata;

evidence.quote: 国家互联网信息办公室起草了《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》，现向社会公开征求意见。
evidence.source_section: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知
evidence.quote_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China has drafted the Measures for Labeling AI-Generated and Synthesized Content (Draft for Comment) and is now soliciting public comments.

enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
implementation_notes: This document is a public consultation notice and un-enacted draft departmental regulation (征求意见稿) issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) on 2024-09-14, so it is coded as regulatory_guidance rather than binding_law. It exempts industry organizations, enterprises, educational/research institutions, public cultural institutions, and professional institutions that develop or apply AI-generated/synthetic content technologies without providing services to the domestic public. The provided text contains Articles 1–6, 10, and 14 (omitting Articles 7–9 and 11–13), and Article 14 leaves the exact 2024 effective date blank.
